svg.title: V3 operation workflow
svg.desc: Dry Run simulates in memory. Lab Repair captures files, repairs the same version and asks for acceptance or file restoration. Upgrade requires a newer version and independent recovery proof.

g.text: Freshservice OSR Upgrade Manager - V3 Preview
1. Start safely: Dry Run is ON
Inspect environment and MSI → simulate steps and decisions → copy the in-memory log
2. Authorized Lab Repair: exact same version, named Hyper-V guest
Preflight → stop Freshworks services → capture and verify files → repair MSI → restart services
Accept result → finish | Reject result → approve file restoration → verify → operator acceptance
Host checkpoint is a separate operator-confirmed lab fallback. Registry and external state are outside this capture.
3. Upgrade: strictly newer MSI and independently validated recovery procedure
Equal-version rejection tested. Cross-version upgrade/rollback remains unqualified in this release.
